title: Z3
description: Documented public SMT solver (Microsoft Research (open source)) for the Universal Constraint Solver capability area.
body:
Z3 is a documented SMT solver from Microsoft Research (open source). Microsoft's satisfiability-modulo-theories solver: decides logical formulas over arithmetic, arrays, and bit-vectors — used in verification, synthesis, and scheduling.

How it works: It works by comparing the dimension vectors of every term in the equation against the first term's, flagging any term whose units disagree.

Documented uses of this capability area include discovering physical laws from experimental data, verifying mathematical proofs, quantifying simulation uncertainty, and calibrating models to measurements.
